BrowserStateBlockParam.description:
The caller's browser state after a browser toolset member call —
the full inventory of open tabs, which tab is active, and any side
effects (tabs opened, download state changes) the call produced.

At most one per `tool_result`, only on a non-error result answering a
browser toolset member `tool_use`. The server renders the
model-visible text from it; the model never sees the raw fields.
BrowserStateBlockParam.title: BrowserStateBlockParam

BrowserStateChangeDownloadCompletedParam.description:
A file download that finished during this call, reported with the
same `download_id` as its `download_started` — or without a prior
`download_started`, when the download finished during the call that
started it (at most one state change per `download_id` per result).
BrowserStateChangeDownloadCompletedParam.title: BrowserStateChangeDownloadCompletedParam

BrowserStateChangeDownloadFailedParam.description: A file download that failed — or was cancelled — during this call.
BrowserStateChangeDownloadFailedParam.title: BrowserStateChangeDownloadFailedParam

BrowserStateChangeDownloadStartedParam.description: A file download that started during this call.
BrowserStateChangeDownloadStartedParam.title: BrowserStateChangeDownloadStartedParam

BrowserStateChangeTabOpenedParam.description:
A tab this call's execution opened that remains open at its end —
the creation delta of the `tabs` inventory, not an event log.

Carries only the `tab_id`; the tab's `title` and `url` live on its
`tabs` entry, which must include the same `tab_id`. A tab opened
during a failed call gets no deferred `tab_opened`; it simply appears
in the next result's `tabs` inventory.
BrowserStateChangeTabOpenedParam.title: BrowserStateChangeTabOpenedParam

BrowserStateTabEntryParam.description:
One open browser tab reported in a `browser_state` block's `tabs`
inventory.

`tab_id` is the caller-assigned identifier for the tab; `title` and
`url` describe the page the tab is currently showing and may be empty
strings (a blank tab legitimately has both empty). `active` marks the
tab that is active after this call; whenever `tabs` is non-empty,
exactly one entry is marked.
BrowserStateTabEntryParam.title: BrowserStateTabEntryParam

BrowserToolset20260801Param.description:
The browser toolset: a single ``tools[]`` entry (carrying no
``name``) that declares the browser tool family. The model is served
the family's tool with any members disabled via ``configs`` removed
from its schema.
BrowserToolset20260801Param.title: BrowserToolset20260801Param

BrowserToolsetConfigsParam.description:
Per-member configuration for ``browser_toolset_20260801``: one
optional field per member tool, keyed by the member name — the same
name the member's ``tool_use`` blocks carry. Every member is an
accepted key, and a member's defaults apply wherever its key is
absent. Unknown keys are rejected: the field set is this toolset
version's complete member set.
BrowserToolsetConfigsParam.title: BrowserToolsetConfigsParam

CacheMissMessagesChanged.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for a request whose `messages` differ from the previous request's in an earlier entry, instead of only having entries appended. The `model`, `system`, and `tools` match.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissMessagesChanged.title: CacheMissMessagesChanged

CacheMissModelChanged.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for a request whose `model` or `speed` differs from the previous request's.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissModelChanged.title: CacheMissModelChanged

CacheMissPreviousMessageNotFound.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for when the API doesn't have a stored record of the request that `diagnostics.previous_message_id` references.

This doesn't mean that this request changed.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissPreviousMessageNotFound.title: CacheMissPreviousMessageNotFound

CacheMissSystemChanged.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for a request whose `system` differs from the previous request's.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissSystemChanged.title: CacheMissSystemChanged

CacheMissToolsChanged.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for a request whose `tools` differ from the previous request's, for example because tools were added, removed, or reordered.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissToolsChanged.title: CacheMissToolsChanged

CacheMissUnavailable.description:
A `cache_miss_reason` for when the API can't give a diagnosis.

The request itself was processed normally.

This includes a request whose `model`, `system`, and `tools` match the previous request's but whose other prompt-affecting parameters, such as `thinking` or `tool_choice`, differ.

See the [cache diagnostics guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/cache-diagnostics#cache-miss-reason-types) to learn what to change for each reason.
CacheMissUnavailable.title: CacheMissUnavailable

CodeExecutionTool20260120Param.description:
A `tools` entry for the code execution tool, version `code_execution_20260120`.

It adds REPL state persistence to version `code_execution_20250825`.

REPL state persistence applies with programmatic tool calling. With it, the Python interpreter state, such as variable bindings, persists across requests that reuse the container.

See the [code execution tool guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool#tool-versions) to learn what each tool version adds.
CodeExecutionTool20260120Param.title: CodeExecutionTool20260120Param

CodeExecutionTool20260521Param.description: Code execution tool with REPL state persistence.
CodeExecutionTool20260521Param.title: CodeExecutionTool20260521Param

ComputerToolset20260801Param.description:
The computer toolset: a single ``tools[]`` entry (carrying no
``name``) that declares the computer tool family. The model is
served the family's tool with any members disabled via ``configs``
removed from its schema. Every member is enabled by default, zoom
included. The single-tool options ``display_number`` and
``enable_zoom`` are not fields of a toolset entry — it carries only
``type``, ``configs``, and ``cache_control``; zoom is controlled
via ``configs.zoom.enabled``.
ComputerToolset20260801Param.title: ComputerToolset20260801Param

ComputerToolsetConfigsParam.description:
Per-member configuration for ``computer_toolset_20260801``: one
optional field per member tool, keyed by the member name — the same
name the member's ``tool_use`` blocks carry. Every member is an
accepted key, and a member's defaults apply wherever its key is
absent. Unknown keys are rejected: the field set is this toolset
version's complete member set.
ComputerToolsetConfigsParam.title: ComputerToolsetConfigsParam

EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlock.description:
The output and exit code of Python code that Claude ran with the code execution tool, with standard output in encrypted form.

The API returns this block in place of `code_execution_result` when the code called the web search tool.

See the [programmatic tool calling guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/programmatic-tool-calling) to learn more about programmatic tool calling.
EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlock.title: EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlock

EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlockParam.description: The output and exit code of Python code that Claude ran with the code execution tool, with standard output in encrypted form, sent back in a later request.
EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlockParam.title: EncryptedCodeExecutionResultBlockParam

ImageTransformationsParam.description: Configures the transformations the server applies to this image before the model observes it. Each key names a condition the server transforms images for; its value selects the transformation applied. Omitted keys keep their default behavior, and an empty object is equivalent to omitting the field.
ImageTransformationsParam.title: ImageTransformationsParam

[JSON schema](https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12) for this tool's input.

ToolChoiceAutoParam.description: The model will automatically decide whether to use tools.

WebFetchURLSourceAllParam.description:
The ``url_sources`` variant under which a source contributes in
full: every result of the tool filter's source, or all user input.
WebFetchURLSourceAllParam.title: WebFetchURLSourceAllParam

WebFetchURLSourceExceptParam.description:
The tool filter variant under which every result but the named
tools' contributes.
WebFetchURLSourceExceptParam.title: WebFetchURLSourceExceptParam

WebFetchURLSourceNoneParam.description:
The ``url_sources`` variant under which a source contributes nothing:
no result of the tool filter's source, or no user input.
WebFetchURLSourceNoneParam.title: WebFetchURLSourceNoneParam

WebFetchURLSourceOnlyParam.description:
The tool filter variant under which only the named tools' results
contribute.
WebFetchURLSourceOnlyParam.title: WebFetchURLSourceOnlyParam

WebFetchURLSourceToolReferenceParam.description:
One entry of a tool filter's ``tools``: it must name a tool declared
in this request's ``tools[]``.
WebFetchURLSourceToolReferenceParam.title: WebFetchURLSourceToolReferenceParam

WebFetchURLSourcesParam.description:
Which sources contribute to the set of URLs web fetch may fetch.

Each key is a tagged variant: ``user_input`` is ``all`` or ``none``; the
two tool filters are ``all``, ``none``, ``only`` (only the named tools'
results) or ``except`` (every result but the named tools'). A named tool
must be declared in this request's ``tools[]``.
WebFetchURLSourcesParam.title: WebFetchURLSourcesParam
